World 110 Task A  -  Shopify Balance Source Intake Overlap & Native Payout Identity Audit:
1. Account-Level Intake Metrics: Account 3345 (sourceDocumentId 11088, importId 7) has 67 source rows, $979.67 net movement, and 36 overlapping rows. Account 3446 (sourceDocumentId 11096, importId 8) has 13 source rows, $53.57 net movement, and 7 overlapping rows. Combined totals across 3345 and 3446 are 80 source rows, $1,033.24 net movement, and 43 overlapping rows (36 and 7 overlapping rows tracked via immutable exact-calendar reimport on a posted-date calendar basis while retaining transaction-date timestamps).
2. Native Payout Identity Guardrail: Both imports have 0 payoutLinks and receiptState=retained_source_only. Legacy candidate_count=1 cannot prove native payout identity for staging, so endingBalancesVerified and payoutIdentityVerified remain false.
